info.description:
# Dropzo API

67 request examples / 61 unique routes (58 versioned + root/liveness/readiness).

Current documentation: https://courier-logistics-backend-lake.vercel.app/docs
Frontend: https://courier-frontend-sigma.vercel.app
Earlier Postman publication: https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/56161283/2sBYB1P8Wz (legacy, 37 requests).

## Import and authenticate
Import the matching Live environment. Enable the cookie jar, fill a dedicated evaluation password locally, send the matching role login, then GET /users/me. HttpOnly cookies carry the session; login JSON does not return access tokens. Cookie-authenticated writes require X-Courier-Client: 1. Log out before switching roles.

## Safety
allow_mutations=false and allow_provider_callbacks=false. Never Run All with writes enabled. Inspect individual requests and variables. Response examples are sanitized illustrative contracts with representative fields, not live captures or payment/delivery evidence. Request tests expect valid successful input; missing cookies/IDs or ineligible state intentionally fail assertions.

## Workflow
Coverage → quote → approved merchant for COD → booking with reviewed quote/version/request UUID → hosted test checkout → provider-verified payment → assignment/pickup → hubs/transit/handoff → recipient acknowledgment → manual cash receipt/payout records.

## Verification
All route definitions are covered. Source/contract checks and mocked browser tests are not proof that every live write or provider payment was exercised. Do not export passwords, cookies, OTPs, OAuth tokens, recipient signatures or provider secrets. See the current reference for source/test/live verification boundaries and publishing instructions.
